senses.en_definition: A set of paper sheets bound together, containing text to read or blank pages to write in; a book or notebook.
A hard joint between sections of a bamboo or sugar cane stem; a rounded prominence at the end of a bone or at a joint.
A small lump or clump of a substance, such as salt or earth.
A classifier used when counting objects in lumps, blocks or bars.

messages.en: You've still got my book, right? Can you bring it along tomorrow?
Yep, I've still got it. Just two pages left to read. I'll finish it tonight.
Okay, see you tomorrow. Don't forget to bring it!

senses.en_definition: A month, a unit of calendar time; in a lunar calendar, a period of 29 or 30 days.

messages.en: Let's go to Penang next month. I'm almost out of money this month.
Sure, sounds good. Early in the month or towards the end? I need to apply for leave first.
The roof over the kitchen's leaking again.
Put a bucket under it for now. I'll call the landlord right away.

senses.en_definition: Earth, the planet we live on and the third planet from the sun.
The ground or land; in literary use, a particular land or region.

messages.en: Did you guys feel that shaking just now? Was it an earthquake?
I felt it too. But I don't know what caused it yet.
